title: Frontend Systems Portfolio
description: Angular frontend systems engineering for audits, refactors, and stabilization.
availability: Available for scoped diagnostics and focused architecture engagements.

credibilityPoints.label: Focus
credibilityPoints.detail: State, data flow, errors, and boundaries.

credibilityPoints.label: Output
credibilityPoints.detail: Findings connect symptoms, risk, and next steps.

nonFitCriteria: Pure visual redesigns without frontend system risk.
Greenfield marketing sites with no product architecture constraints.
Open-ended staff augmentation without a scoped outcome.

about.context: Frontend systems engineer focused on Angular applications where state, data access, ownership, and errors have become hard to reason about.
about.philosophy: Most frontend problems are not framework problems. They are boundary problems: places where ownership was never declared, where the next person had to guess, where "it works" became the only definition of done. I am interested in the work that makes those boundaries visible before they become expensive.
workingStyle: Start with a small diagnostic and make the current system visible before prescribing changes.
Prefer explicit boundaries, typed contracts, and practical migration steps over large rewrites.
Work in short feedback loops with engineering leads and product constraints in view.
qualityPhilosophy: Architecture should reduce the number of places a team has to remember hidden rules.
Tests are most valuable when they pin important behavior and risky seams, not when they mirror implementation.
Refactors should leave a trail of decisions, tradeoffs, and rollback options.
about.communication: Based in Asia/Bangkok and comfortable with async-first collaboration across US and European time zones.
